name: python_declaration_keyword
description: Choose the Python keyword that begins a function declaration versus a class declaration, with identifier-copy controls.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
 fn=bool(i%2);name=random.choice(['Widget','Parser','Reader','Agent','Handler','Worker','Builder','Client']) if not fn else random.choice(['process','parse','read','compute','handle','work','build','connect'])
 desc='function' if fn else 'class'
 p=f'In Python, declare a new {desc} named {name}. '
 items.append({'prompt':p+'What keyword begins the declaration? Keyword:', 'answer':' '+('def' if fn else 'class')})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'What is the requested identifier? Identifier:', 'answer':' '+name})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
